214  /**
215   * @return bool
216   */
217  public function bound():bool
218  {
219    return $this->requestParameters !== null;
220  }

222  /**
223   * @param array $requestParameters Bind self to the
224   * given request parameters.
225   *
226   * @return void
227   */
228  public function bind(array $requestParameters):void
229  {
230    $this->requestParameters = $requestParameters;
231
232    // Fetch all data submitted by form
233    $this->cgiData = $this->requestParameters[self::POST_TAG] ?? [];
234
235    // The web-form submits the basic recipient set as array
236    $values = array_flip($this->cgiData[self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY] ?? []);
237
238    $this->cgiData[self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY][self::FROM_PROJECT_CONFIRMED_KEY] =
239      isset($values[self::FROM_PROJECT_CONFIRMED_KEY]);
240    $this->cgiData[self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY][self::FROM_PROJECT_PRELIMINARY_KEY] =
241      isset($values[self::FROM_PROJECT_PRELIMINARY_KEY]);
242    $this->cgiData[self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY][self::EXCEPT_PROJECT_KEY] =
243      isset($values[self::EXCEPT_PROJECT_KEY]);
244    $this->cgiData[self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY][self::ANNOUNCEMENTS_MAILING_LIST_KEY] =
245      isset($values[self::ANNOUNCEMENTS_MAILING_LIST_KEY]);
246    $this->cgiData[self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY][self::PROJECT_MAILING_LIST_KEY] =
247      isset($values[self::PROJECT_MAILING_LIST_KEY]);
248
249    $this->projectId = (int)($this->requestParameters['projectId'] ?? 0);
250    $this->projectName = $this->requestParameters['projectName'] ?? '';
251    $this->project = null;
252    if ($this->projectId > 0) {
253      $this->project = $this->getDatabaseRepository(Entities\Project::class)
254        ->find($this->projectId);
255    }
256
257    $this->bulkTransaction = null;
258    $this->donationReceipt = null;
259    $this->invoice = null;
260    $this->bulkTransactionId = $this->requestParameters['bulkTransactionId'] ?? 0;
261    if ($this->bulkTransactionId > 0) {
262      $this->bulkTransaction = $this->getDatabaseRepository(Entities\SepaBulkTransaction::class)
263                                    ->find($this->bulkTransactionId);
264    }
265
266    $this->donationReceiptId = $this->requestParameters['donationReceiptId'] ?? 0;
267    if ($this->donationReceiptId > 0) {
268      $this->donationReceipt = $this->getDatabaseRepository(Entities\DonationReceipt::class)
269                                    ->find($this->donationReceiptId);
270    }
271
272    $this->invoiceId = (int)($this->requestParameters[ComposerCgiKeys::INVOICE_ID] ?? 0);
273    if ($this->invoiceId > 0) {
274      if ($this->bulkTransactionId > 0 || $this->donationReceiptId > 0) {
275        throw new RuntimeException($this->l->t('An invoice cannot be combined with a bulk transaction or donation receipt in the email form.'));
276      }
277      $this->invoice = $this->getDatabaseRepository(Entities\Invoice::class)->find($this->invoiceId);
278      if (empty($this->invoice)) {
279        throw new RuntimeException($this->l->t('Unable to find the invoice with id %d.', [$this->invoiceId]));
280      }
281    }
282
283    // See wether we were passed specific variables ...
284    $this->emailKey  = $this->pme->cgiSysName(PHPMyEdit::MRECS_KEY);
285    $this->mkeyKey   = $this->pme->cgiSysName('mkey');
286    $this->mtabKey   = $this->pme->cgiSysName('mtable');
287    $this->emailRecs = []; // avoid null
288
289    $this->frozen = $this->cgiValue(RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::FROZEN_RECIPIENTS, false);
290
291    $this->execute();
292  }

294  /**
295   * Parse the CGI stuff and compute the list of selected musicians,
296   * either for the initial form setup as during the interaction
297   * with the user.
298   *
299   * @return void
300   */
301  private function execute():void
302  {
303    // Maybe should also check something else. If submitted is true,
304    // then we use the form data, otherwise the defaults.
305    $this->submitted = $this->cgiValue(RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::FORM_STATUS, '') === EnumFormStatus::SUBMITTED->value;
306
307    // "sane" default setttings
308    $this->emailRecs = $this->requestParameters[$this->emailKey] ?? [];
309    $this->emailTable = $this->requestParameters[$this->mtabKey] ?? '';
310
311    $this->reload = false;
312    $this->snapshot = false;
313
314    if ($this->submitted) {
315      $this->loadHistory(); // Fetch the filter-history from the session, if any.
316      $this->emailRecs = $this->cgiValue($this->emailKey, []);
317      $this->emailTable = $this->cgiValue($this->mtabKey);
318      if ($this->cgiValue(RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::RESET_INSTRUMENTS_FILTER, false) !== false) {
319        $this->submitted = false; // fall back to defaults for everything
320        $this->cgiData = [];
321        $this->reload = true;
322      } elseif ($this->cgiValue(RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::UNDO_INSTRUMENTS_FILTER, false) !== false) {
323        $this->applyHistory(1); // the current state
324        $this->reload = true;
325      } elseif ($this->cgiValue(RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::REDO_INSTRUMENTS_FILTER, false) !== false) {
326        $this->applyHistory(-1);
327        $this->reload = true;
328      } elseif ($this->cgiValue(self::HISTORY_SNAPSHOT_KEY, false) !== false) {
329        // fast mode, only CGI data, no DB access. Only the
330        // $this->filterHistory() should be queried afterwards,
331        // everything else is undefined.
332        $this->snapshot = true;
333        $this->pushHistory(true);
334        $this->storeHistory();
335        return;
336      }
337    }
338
339    $this->remapEmailRecords();
340    $this->determineUserBase();
341    $this->getParticiationStatusNames();
342    $this->initParticiationStatusFilter();
343    $this->getInstrumentsFromDB();
344    $this->fetchInstrumentsFilter();
345    $this->getMusiciansFromDB();
346
347    if (!$this->submitted) {
348      // Do this at end in order to have any tweaks around
349      $this->setDefaultHistory();
350    } elseif (!$this->reload) {
351      $previousRecipientSet = $this->filterHistory[$this->historyPosition]['data'][self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY] ?? [];
352      // $this->logInfo('PREV RCPTS ' . print_r($previousRecipientSet, true));
353      // $this->logInfo('USER BASE ' . $this->userBase);
354      if (!empty($this->project)
355          && !$this->announcementsMailingList() && !$this->projectMailingList()
356          && ($previousRecipientSet[self::EXCEPT_PROJECT_KEY] != $this->recipientsExceptProject())) {
357        // if in project mode and not using a mailing list and posting to/not
358        // to the non-participants has changed then reset the participation-status
359        // filter.
360        $this->participationStatusFilter = $this->defaultByParticipationStatus();
361      }
362      // add the current selection to the history if it is different
363      // from the previous filter selection (i.e.: no-ops like
364      // hitten apply over and over again or multiple double-clicks
365      // will not alter the history.
366      $this->pushHistory();
367    }
368
369    $this->storeHistory();
370  }

372  /**
373   * Fetch a CGI-variable out of the form-select name-space.
374   *
375   * @param string $key The pareter key to query.
376   *
377   * @param mixed $default The default value.
378   *
379   * @return mixed
380   */
381  private function cgiValue(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
382  {
383    if (isset($this->cgiData[$key])) {
384      $value = $this->cgiData[$key];
385      if (is_string($value)) {
386        $value = trim($value);
387      }
388      return $value;
389    } else {
390      return $default;
391    }
392  }

400  {

403
404    $filter = [
405      self::BASIC_RECIPIENTS_SET_KEY => $this->basicRecipientsSet(),

407      'instrumentsFilter' => [],

409        $this->emailRecs,
410        array_keys($this->eMailsDpy??[])
411      )
412    ];
413
414    // tweak: sort the selected recipients by key

416
417    $md5 = md5(serialize($filter));

437  /**

442  private function loadHistory():bool

457  /**
458   * Validate the given history records, return false on error.
459   *
460   * @param bool|array $history The history to validate.
461   *
462   * @return bool Validation result.
463   */
464  private function validateHistory(mixed $history):bool
465  {
466    if ($history === false ||
467        !isset($history['size']) ||
468        !isset($history['position']) ||
469        !isset($history['records']) ||
470        !$this->validateHistoryRecords($history)) {
471      return false;
472    }
473    return true;
474  }
475
476  /**
477   * Validate one history entry
478   *
479   * @param mixed $record The history record. Intentionally an array.
480   *
481   * @return bool Validation result.
482   */
483  private function validateHistoryRecord(mixed $record):bool
484  {
485    if (!is_array($record)) {
486      return false;
487    }
488    if (!isset($record['md5']) || !isset($record['data'])) {
489      return false;
490    }
491    $md5 = md5(serialize($record['data']));
492    if ($record['md5'] != $md5) {
493      return false;
494    }
495    return true;
496  }
497
498  /**
499   * Validate all history records.
500   *
501   * @param array $history The filter history.
502   *
503   * @return bool Validation result.
504   */
505  private function validateHistoryRecords(array $history):bool
506  {
507    foreach ($history['records'] as $record) {
508      if (!$this->validateHistoryRecord($record)) {
509        return false;
510      }
511    }
512    return true;
513  }
514
515  /**
516   * Push the current filter selection onto the undo-history
517   * stack. Do nothing for dummy commits, i.e. only a changed filter
518   * will be pushed onto the stack.
519   *
520   * @param bool $fastMode If true omit normalization attempts.
521   *
522   * @return void
523   */
524  private function pushHistory(bool $fastMode = false):void
525  {
526    $filter = [];
527    foreach (self::HISTORY_KEYS as $key) {
528      $filter[$key] = $this->cgiValue($key, []);
529    }
530
531    if (!$fastMode) {
532      // exclude musicians deselected by the filter from the set of
533      // selected recipients before recording the history
534      $filter[RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::SELECTED_RECIPIENTS] =
535        array_intersect(
536          $filter[RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::SELECTED_RECIPIENTS],
537          array_keys($this->eMailsDpy)
538        );
539
540      // tweak: sort the selected recipients by key
541    }
542
543    sort($filter[RecipientsFilterCgiKeys::SELECTED_RECIPIENTS]);
544    $md5 = md5(serialize($filter));
545
546    /* Avoid pushing duplicate history entries. If the new
547     * filter-record matches the current one, then simply discard
548     * the new filter. This is in order to avoid bloating the
549     * history records by repeated user submits of the same filter
550     * or duplicated double-clicks.
551     */
552    $historyFilter = $this->filterHistory[$this->historyPosition];
553    if ($historyFilter['md5'] != $md5) {
554      // Pushing a new record removes the history up to the current
555      // position, i.e. redos are not longer possible then. This
556      // seems to be common behaviour as "re-doing" is no longer
557      // well defined in this case.
558      array_splice($this->filterHistory, 0, $this->historyPosition);
559      array_unshift($this->filterHistory, [ 'md5' => $md5, 'data' => $filter ]);
560      $this->historyPosition = 0;
561      $this->historySize = count($this->filterHistory);
562      while ($this->historySize > self::MAX_HISTORY_SIZE) {
563        array_pop($this->filterHistory);
564        --$this->historySize;
565      }
566    }
567  }
568
569  /**
570   * @param int $offset Relative move inside the history. The function will
571   * throw an exception if emailform-debuggin is enabled and the requested
572   * action would leave the history stack.
573   *
574   * @return void
575   */
576  private function applyHistory(int $offset):void
577  {
578    $newPosition = $this->historyPosition + $offset;
579
580    // Check for valid position.
581    if ($newPosition >= $this->historySize || $newPosition < 0) {
582      if ($this->shouldDebug(ConfigConstants::DEBUG_EMAILFORM)) {
583        throw new OutOfBoundsException(
584          $this->l->t(
585            'Invalid history position %d request, history size is %d',
586            [ $newPosition, $this->historySize ])
587        );
588      }
589      return;
590    }
591
592    // Move to the new history position.
593    $this->historyPosition = $newPosition;
594
595    $filter = $this->filterHistory[$newPosition]['data'];
596    foreach (self::HISTORY_KEYS as $key) {
597      $this->cgiData[$key] = $filter[$key];
598    }
599  }
600
601  /**
602   * This function is called at the very start. For special purpose
603   * emails this function forms the list of recipients.
604   *
605   * @return void
606   */
607  private function remapEmailRecords():void
608  {
609    if (!empty($this->bulkTransaction)) {
610
611      $payments = $this->bulkTransaction->getPayments();
612      if (empty($payments)) {
613        throw new RuntimeException(
614          $this->l->t('No payments for bulk-transaction id %d.', [ $this->bulkTransactionId ])
615        );
616      }
617      $this->emailRecs = [];
618      foreach ($payments as $payment) {
619        $this->emailRecs[] = $payment->getMusician()->getId();
620      }
621
622      $this->frozen = true; // restrict to initial set of recipients
623
624      return;
625    } elseif (!empty($this->donationReceipt)) {
626
627      $payment = $this->donationReceipt->getDonation();
628      if (empty($payment)) {
629        throw new RuntimeException(
630          $this->l->t('No payment attached to the donation receipt with id %d.', [ $this->donationReceiptId ])
631        );
632      }
633      $this->emailRecs = [];
634      $this->emailRecs[] = $payment->getMusician()->getId(); // only a single recipient
635
636      $this->frozen = true; // restrict to initial set of recipients
637
638      return;
639    } elseif (!empty($this->invoice)) {
640      $debitor = $this->invoice->getDebitor();
641      if (empty($debitor)) {
642        throw new RuntimeException(
643          $this->l->t('No debitor attached to the invoice with id %d.', [$this->invoiceId])
644        );
645      }
646      $this->emailRecs = [$debitor->getId()];
647      $this->frozen = true;
648
649      return;
650    } elseif (!empty($this->emailTable)) {
651      $musicianKey = self::MUSICIAN_KEY[$this->emailTable];
652      $this->emailRecs = array_filter(
653        array_map(
654          function($keyRecord) use ($musicianKey) {
655            // @todo Quite inefficient
656            $musicianId = filter_var($keyRecord, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
657            if ($musicianId !== false) {
658              return $musicianId;
659            }
660            return json_decode($keyRecord, true)[$musicianKey];
661          },
662          $this->emailRecs));
663    }
664  }
665
666  /**
667   * Form an associative array with the keys
668   * - name (full name)
669   * - email
670   * - status (ParticiationStatus)
671   * - dbdata (data as returned from the DB for variable substitution)
672   * The function fills $this->eMails, $this->eMailsDpy
673   *
674   * @param array $criteria Filter criteria for the list of recipients.
675   *
676   * @return void
677   */
678  private function fetchMusicians(array $criteria):void
679  {
680    // add the instruments filter
681    if (!empty($this->instrumentsFilter)) {
682      $criteria[] = [ 'instruments.instrument' => $this->instrumentsFilter ];
683      if ($this->projectId > 0 && ($this->userBase & self::MUSICIANS_EXCEPT_PROJECT) == 0) {
684        $criteria[] = [ 'projectInstruments.instrument' => $this->instrumentsFilter ];
685        $criteria[] = [ 'projectInstruments.project' => $this->projectId ];
686      }
687    }
688    if ($this->frozen && $this->projectId > 0) {
689      $criteria[] = [ 'id' => $this->emailRecs ];
690    }
691    if ($this->projectId <= 0) {
692      $criteria[] = [ '!defaultParticipationStatus' => $this->participationStatusBlackList() ];
693    } else {
694      $criteria[] = [ '(|' => true ];
695      $criteria[] = [ '(&projectParticipation.project' => $this->projectId ];
696      $criteria[] = [ '!projectParticipation.participationStatus' => $this->participationStatusBlackList() ];
697      $criteria[] = [ ')' => true ];
698      $criteria[] = [ '(&!projectParticipation.project' => $this->projectId ];
699      $criteria[] = [ '!defaultParticipationStatus' => $this->participationStatusBlackList() ];
700      $criteria[] = [ ')' => true ];
701      $criteria[] = [ ')' => true ];
702    }
703    // $criteria[] = [ '(|deleted' => null ];
704    // $criteria[] = [ '>=deleted' => new DateTimeImmutable() ];
705
706    $softDeleteableState = $this->enableFilter(EntityManager::SOFT_DELETEABLE_FILTER);
707    $musicians = $this->musiciansRepository->findBy($criteria, [ 'id' => 'INDEX' ]);
708    $this->enableFilter(EntityManager::SOFT_DELETEABLE_FILTER, $softDeleteableState);
709
710    // $this->logInfo('MUSICIANS FOUND ' . count($musicians) . ' CRITERIA ' . print_r($criteria, true));
711
712    // use the mailer-class we are using later anyway in order to
713    // validate email addresses syntactically now. Add broken
714    // addresses to the "brokenEMails" list.
715    $mailer = new PHPMailer;
716
717    /** @var Entities\Musician $musician */
718    foreach ($musicians as $rec => $musician) {
719
720      $displayName = $musician->getPublicName(true);
721      if (!empty($musician->getEmail())) {
722        // We allow comma separated multiple addresses
723        $musMail = explode(',', $musician->getEmail());
724        foreach ($musMail as $emailVal) {
725          if (!$mailer->validateAddress($emailVal)) {
726            $bad = htmlspecialchars($displayName.' <'.$emailVal.'>');
727            if (isset($this->brokenEMails[$rec])) {
728              $this->brokenEMails[$rec]['label'] .= ', '.$bad;
729            } else {
730              $this->brokenEMails[$rec] = [
731                'participant' => $this->projectId > 0 && $musician->isMemberOf($this->projectId),
732                'label' => $bad,
733              ];
734
735            }
736          } else {
737            $participant = !empty($this->project) ? $musician->getProjectParticipantOf($this->project) : null;
738            $isParticipant = !empty($participant);
739            $isNonParticipant = $this->projectId > 0 && !$isParticipant;
740            $userBase = 0;
741            if ($isParticipant) {
742              $userBase |= self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT;
743            } elseif ($isNonParticipant) {
744              $userBase |= self::MUSICIANS_EXCEPT_PROJECT;
745            }
746            if ($isParticipant) {
747              $status = $participant->getParticipationStatus();
748            } else {
749              $status = $musician->getDefaultParticipationStatus();
750            }
751            $emailRecord = [
752              'email'   => $emailVal,
753              'name'    => $displayName,
754              'status'  => $status,
755              'project' => $this->projectId ?? 0,
756              'participant' => $isParticipant,
757              'userBase' => $userBase,
758              'dbdata'  => $musician,
759            ];
760            $this->eMails[$rec] = $emailRecord;
761            $this->eMailsDpy[$rec] = htmlspecialchars($displayName.' <'.$emailVal.'>');
762          }
763        }
764      } else {
765        $this->brokenEMails[$rec] = [
766          'participant' => $this->projectId > 0 && $musician->isMemberOf($this->projectId),
767          'label' => htmlspecialchars($displayName),
768        ];
769      }
770    }
771  }

773  /**
774   * Fetch the list of musicians for the given context (project/global).
775   *
776   * @return void
777   */
778  private function getMusiciansFromDB():void
779  {
780    $this->brokenEMails = [];
781    $this->eMails = [];
782    $this->eMailsDpy = []; // display records
783
784    $userBase = $this->userBase & self::DATABASE_MUSICIANS;
785    $criteria = [];
786    if (!empty($this->project) && $userBase != self::ALL_MUSICIANS) {
787
788      // OK, perhaps one should switch to sub-queries ...
789      //
790      // The problem is here that we need HAVING clauses in order to filter by
791      // the project id. WHERE and HAVING are implicitly joined by an AND, so
792      // we cannot first restrict to confirmed participation in the current
793      // project by WHERE and later allow non-project-musicians by HAVING.
794
795      if (($userBase & self::MUSICIANS_EXCEPT_PROJECT) && ($userBase & self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT)) {
796        $criteria[] = [
797          "(|projectParticipation.project@GROUP_CONCAT(IF(IDENTITY(%s) = {$this->projectId}, 1, NULL))" => null
798          // "(|projectParticipation.project@GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN IDENTITY(%s) = {$this->projectId} THEN 1 ELSE NULL END))" => null
799        ];
800        if ($userBase & self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT_CONFIRMED) {
801          $criteria[] = [
802            "projectParticipation.project@GROUP_CONCAT(IF(IDENTITY(%s) = {$this->projectId}, projectParticipation.registration, NULL))" => 1
803          ];
804        } else {
805          $criteria[] = [
806            "projectParticipation.project@GROUP_CONCAT(IF(IDENTITY(%s) = {$this->projectId}, NULLIF(projectParticipation.registration, 0), NULL))" => null
807          ];
808        }
809        $criteria[] = [ ')@' => true ];
810      } elseif ($userBase & self::MUSICIANS_EXCEPT_PROJECT) {
811        $criteria[] = [
812          "projectParticipation.project@GROUP_CONCAT(IF(IDENTITY(%s) = {$this->projectId}, 1, NULL))" => null
813        ];
814      } elseif ($userBase & self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT) {
815        $criteria[] = [ '(&projectParticipation.project' => $this->projectId ];
816        switch ($userBase & self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT) {
817          case self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT:
818            break; // just all participants
819          case self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT_CONFIRMED:
820            $criteria[] = [ 'projectParticipation.registration' => 1 ];
821            break;
822          case self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT_PRELIMINARY:
823            $criteria[] = [ '(|projectParticipation.registration' => 0 ];
824            $criteria[] = [ 'projectParticipation.registration' => null ];
825            $criteria[] = [ ')' => true ];
826            break;
827        }
828        $criteria[] = [ ')' => true ];
829      }
830      if (empty($criteria)) {
831        $this->logError('EMPTY CRITERIA "' . $this->userBase . '"');
832        return;
833      }
834    }
835    $this->fetchMusicians($criteria);
836
837    // Finally sort the display array
838    asort($this->eMailsDpy);
839  }

841  /**
842   * Fetch the list of instruments (either only for project or all)
843   *
844   * Also: construct the filter by instrument.
845   *
846   * @return void
847   */
848  private function getInstrumentsFromDb():void
849  {
850    $instrumentInfo =
851      $this->getDatabaseRepository(Entities\Instrument::class)->describeALL();
852    // Get the current list of instruments for the filter
853    if ($this->projectId > 0 && !($this->userBase & self::MUSICIANS_EXCEPT_PROJECT)) {
854      $this->instruments = [];
855      // @todo Perhaps write a special repository-method
856      $projectInstruments = $this->project->getParticipantInstruments()->toArray();
857      usort($projectInstruments, fn(Entities\ProjectInstrument $a, Entities\ProjectInstrument $b) => $a->getInstrument()->getSortOrder() - $b->getInstrument()->getSortOrder());
858      foreach ($projectInstruments as $projectInstrument) {

861      }

864    }

868  /**
869   * Fetch the instruments filter from the CGI parameters.
870   *
871   * @return void
872   */

1023      }

1361   * server, see MailingListsService::LIST_INFO_KEYS.
1362   */
1363  public function getMailingListInfo(string $which = self::PROJECT_MAILING_LIST_KEY)
1364  {
1365    if (empty($this->mailingListInfo[$which])) {
1366      $listId = null;
1367      /** @var MailingListsService $listsService */
1368      $listsService = $this->di(MailingListsService::class);
1369      if (!$listsService->isConfigured()) {
1370        return null;
1371      }
1372      switch ($which) {
1373        case self::PROJECT_MAILING_LIST_KEY:
1374          if (empty($this->project)) {
1375            return null;
1376          }
1377          $listId = $this->project->getMailingListId();
1378          break;
1379        case self::ANNOUNCEMENTS_MAILING_LIST_KEY:
1380          $listId = $this->getConfigValue($which);
1381          break;
1382      }
1383      if (!empty($listId)) {
1384        try {
1385          $this->mailingListInfo[$which] = $listsService->getListInfo($listId);
1386        } catch (\Throwable $t) {
1387          $this->logException($t, 'Unable to contact REST interface of mailing list service');
1388        }
1389      }
1390    }
1391    return $this->mailingListInfo[$which] ?? null;
1392  }
1393
1394  /**
1395   * Substitute the recipients by the announcements mailing list if
1396   * possible. The composer does this if the email does not contain personal
1397   * substitutions.
1398   *
1399   * @param array $selectedRecipients Recipients-set in the form returned by
1400   * RecipientsFilter::selectedRecipients().
1401   *
1402   * @return bool \true if the recipients list has been altered, \false if it
1403   * has been left as is.
1404   */
1405  public function substituteAnnouncementsMailingList(array &$selectedRecipients):bool
1406  {
1407    if ($this->announcementsMailingList()) {
1408      return true;
1409    }
1410    if (!empty($this->project) && ($this->userBase & self::DATABASE_MUSICIANS) != self::ALL_MUSICIANS) {
1411      return false;
1412    }
1413    if (!empty($this->instrumentsFilter)) {
1414      return false;
1415    }
1416    $defaultByParticipationStatus = $this->defaultByParticipationStatus();
1417    $participationStatusFilter = $this->participationStatusFilter ?? [];
1418    if (array_diff($defaultByParticipationStatus, $participationStatusFilter) !== array_diff($participationStatusFilter, $defaultByParticipationStatus)) {
1419      return false;
1420    }
1421
1422    $numberOfPossibleRecipients = count($this->emailRecipientsChoices());
1423    $numberOfSelectedRecipients = count($selectedRecipients);
1424
1425    if ($numberOfPossibleRecipients != $numberOfSelectedRecipients) {
1426      return false;
1427    }
1428
1429    if (empty($this->getMailingListInfo(self::ANNOUNCEMENTS_MAILING_LIST_KEY))) {
1430      return false;
1431    }
1432
1433    $selectedRecipients = $this->selectedRecipients(self::ANNOUNCEMENTS_MAILING_LIST);
1434
1435    return true;
1436  }
1437
1438  /**
1439   * Possibly replace part of the given recipients set by the project-mailing list:
1440   * - if the list contains recipients NOT in the given set, then DON'T
1441   * - if the given set covers the mailing list, then DO
1442   * - in any case keep the recipients not contained in the mailing list
1443   * - only recipients with active delivery are considered
1444   *
1445   * @param array $selectedRecipients Recipients-set in the form returned by
1446   * RecipientsFilter::selectedRecipients().
1447   *
1448   * @return bool \true If the recipients list has been tweaked, \false if it
1449   * has not been altered.
1450   */
1451  public function substituteProjectMailingList(array &$selectedRecipients):bool
1452  {
1453    if (empty($this->project)) {
1454      // this is not a project email
1455      $this->logInfo('NO PROJECT');
1456      return false;
1457    }
1458
1459    if (!($this->userBase & self::MUSICIANS_FROM_PROJECT_CONFIRMED)) {
1460      // intentionally not for the list which should contain all confirmed
1461      // participants + further people.
1462      $this->logInfo('NOT FOR THE LIST');
1463      return false;
1464    }
1465
1466    $defaultByParticipationStatus = $this->defaultByParticipationStatus();
1467    $participationStatusFilter = $this->participationStatusFilter ?? [];
1468    if (array_intersect($participationStatusFilter, $defaultByParticipationStatus) != $defaultByParticipationStatus) {
1469      // intentionally not for the list as less than the default status type
1470      // were addressed
1471      $this->logInfo('MEMBER FILTER INCOMPATIBLE ' . print_r($defaultByParticipationStatus, true) . ' ' . print_r($participationStatusFilter, true));
1472      return false;
1473    }
1474
1475    if (!empty($this->instrumentsFilter)) {
1476      // intentionally not for the list, which is also archived
1477      $this->logInfo('INSTRUMENTS FILTER NOT EMPTY');
1478      return false;
1479    }
1480
1481    $numberOfPossibleRecipients = count($this->emailRecipientsChoices());
1482    $numberOfSelectedRecipients = count($selectedRecipients);
1483    if ($numberOfPossibleRecipients != $numberOfSelectedRecipients) {
1484      // although the recipient options intentionally include the list members
1485      // there is a particular choice of selected recipients, so this should
1486      // not go to the list.
1487      $this->logInfo('SPECIFIC CHOICE OF RECIPIENTS');
1488      return false;
1489    }
1490
1491    // keep this check last as it implies a REST call which is time-consuming.
1492    $listInfo = $this->getMailingListInfo();
1493    if (empty($listInfo)) {
1494      // well, there is not list ...
1495      return false;
1496    }
1497
1498    $listId = $listInfo['list_id'];
1499    /** @var MailingListsService $listsService */
1500    $listsService = $this->di(MailingListsService::class);
1501    $listMembers = $listsService->findMembers($listId, flat: true, criteria: [
1502      MailingListsService::MEMBER_DELIVERY_STATUS => MailingListsService::DELIVERY_STATUS_ENABLED,
1503      MailingListsService::MEMBER_DELIVERY_MODE => MailingListsService::DELIVERY_MODE_REGULAR,
1504    ]);
1505    $bulkEmailFromAddress = $this->getConfigValue(ConfigConstants::EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS_KEY);
1506    Util::unsetValue($listMembers, $bulkEmailFromAddress);
1507    $recipientsByEmail = [];
1508    foreach ($selectedRecipients as $recipient) {
1509      $recipientsByEmail[$recipient['email']] = $recipient;
1510    }
1511    $remainingRecipients = array_diff_key($recipientsByEmail, array_flip($listMembers));
1512    if (!empty($remainingRecipients)) {
1513      $this->logInfo('NOT ON THE LIST ' . print_r(array_keys($remainingRecipients), true));
1514    }
1515
1516    $remainingListMembers = array_diff($listMembers, array_keys($recipientsByEmail));
1517    if (!empty($remainingListMembers)) {
1518      $this->logInfo('EXCESS MEMBERS ON THE MAILING LIST ' . print_r($remainingListMembers, true));
1519      // It is ok if there are more members on the list, as intentionally this
1520      // should be mailing list traffic.  return false;
1521    }
1522
1523    // throw away all recipients which are also reached by posting to the list
1524    // and add the list address as additional recipient.
1525    $selectedRecipients = array_merge(
1526      $this->selectedRecipients(self::PROJECT_MAILING_LIST),
1527      array_values($remainingRecipients),
1528    );
1529    return true;
1530  }
